body:
I've been looking for a good psychoactive plant to grow in my yard this spring, so I decided to experiment with some wild dagga flowers. I bought a fourth of an ounce for about 10 bucks, and it finally came in the mail today. The flowers are small, orange, and tubular, and they have a flowery-cherry smell to them, which perfectly matched their color.
I crumbled them up and put them into 2 joints and smoked them. They burn pretty quickly and easily, and the smoke is a little heavy but not too bad. I begin to feel the effects 10 min later.
I should've known that the high from the flowers was gonna be exactly like the smell and color of them - direct, energetic, and up-lifting. The high was about half as strong as pot, and it invigorated me with energy and lifted my mood up; I felt like I had to get up and start dancing (which I did!). The effects lasted for about an hour.
All in all, I would rate wild dagga as a good, legal recreational herb. Its good to smoke with buddies, at a party, or doing basic work. However, I wouldn't smoke it for relaxation (I leave that to the weed!).
